content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello! Thank you for sending over the agreement. I am excited to work together, and I just have one minor adjustment to suggest before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause, payment is currently deferred to 45 days and conditioned on invoice confirmation, which puts the timeline under the client's control; I propose changing this so that the client shall pay all undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt. Thank you for your flexibility, and I look forward to your response.
